+def _scheduling(data):
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+            if job["id"] not in set(data.get("blocked", []))]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    for mask in range(1 << len(jobs)):
+        selected = [jobs[i] for i in range(len(jobs)) if mask & (1 << i)]
+        if len(selected) != k:
+            continue
+        ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in selected))
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in selected:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(selected, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["end"] > ordered[i + 1]["start"]
+               for i in range(len(ordered) - 1)):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in selected)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value
+                or (value == best_value and ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+

+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit_for = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    source = data["source"]
+    target = data["target"]
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    initial_mask = bit_for.get(source, 0)
+    initial = (source, initial_mask, 0)
+    distances = {initial: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, 0)]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == target and mask == full and used == coupons:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            options = [(edge["duration"], used)]
+            if used < coupons:
+                duration = max(1, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                options.append((duration, used + 1))
+            for duration, next_used in options:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit_for.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, next_used)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, next_node, next_mask, next_used))
+    return {"arrival": None}
